title: Taiwan international commercial port access nodes and activity baseline

coverage.description: Seven international commercial ports officially identified by Taiwan International Ports Corporation, with Ministry of the Interior source points and twelve complete months of prebookmark activity.

known_gaps: Independent infrastructure review has not passed.
The source locations are landmark points, not harbor polygons, berth geometry, storage areas, channels, or engineering capacity.
Observed traffic is a utilization baseline and must not be interpreted as maximum throughput or mobilization capacity.
The wharf resource is a postbookmark live snapshot; only records carrying source update months no later than August 2025 are admitted.
Military facilities, military access, defenses, and targeting semantics are intentionally excluded.
notes: This packet supports trade, logistics, blockade, evacuation, and access mechanics after a separate simulation contract is accepted. It does not create strike targets or executable capacity by itself.
